AUTHOR: Catalán
TITLE: Automatic detection and classification of coastal Mediterranean fish from underwater images: Good practices for robust training
REGION: Andratx Bay and Palma Bay, Mallorca (Balearic Islands) and OBSEA observatory, Catalonia, Spain (coastal Mediterranean)
SPECIES: 20+ coastal Mediterranean classes, main analyses on 9-14 (Chromis chromis, Diplodus sargus, D. vulgaris, D. annularis, Serranus scriba, Seriola dumerilii, Oblada melanura, Coris julis, Lithognathus mormyrus, Pomatomus saltatrix, Mugilidae, etc.); plus generic 'fish'
DATA: Own datasets A (Subeye cabled camera, wreck, 6 m), B (drop-down and diver GoPro, 5-20 m), C (second fixed camera, 8 m), D (OBSEA observatory, Catalonia); >18,400 labelled fish in >1,600 images; A-C released on Zenodo
V_EV: Methods: 'The obtained images included depths ranging from 5 to 20 meters'; camera A 'within the wreck (6 m depth)'; no turbidity/visibility measure or stratified results
D2: A+B: 1,338 train / 327 validation images (~20%) + small test sets (15 and 13 images); external tests C (43 images) and D (21 images)
D_EV: Methods: 'Training and validation (approx 20% of the images)'; Table 1 note: 'A and B datasets were split into training, validation and test sets' - image-level split, no grouping stated
R_EV: Table 1 / Methods: 'test sets C and D were obtained from different areas and backgrounds'; Table 4 YOLO E0 mAP@0.5 = 0.84 (A), 0.83 (B), 0.80 (C), 0.78 (D)
C_EV: Models metrics: 'The P and R values from the nets were obtained so that they maximized the F1 score'; no multi-threshold analysis, calibration or uncertainty reported
E_EV: Results: 'YOLO performed notably better than Faster RCNN ... with mAP@0.5 values over 0.8'; only P, R, F1, mAP and confusion matrices reported
ARCH: YOLOv5m (Ultralytics, COCO-pretrained) vs Faster R-CNN ResNet50 (TensorFlow, ImageNet-pretrained) for fish detection; EfficientNetV2 classifier vs YOLO for species; Multiscale Retinex (MSR) image enhancement
METR: Precision, recall, F1 (at F1-maximising operating point), mAP@0.5, confusion matrices
NOTE: New labelled dataset released (Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.7534425) - could also be TYPE = 데이터셋+실험. Split is at image level (dataset A is 5-min time-lapse stills, B is video frames) but the paper does not state whether the split was random; coded 이미지/프레임 무작위 as nearest category. External tests C (different camera, 4 m from wreck) and D (OBSEA, Catalonia) give R_ALL = Y with per-test-set mAP (Table 4). PRE = COCO for the selected YOLOv5m; Faster R-CNN used ImageNet. Discussion recommends separating analyses by object size but no size-stratified results are given (E4 = 없음). Visibility only via depth (V2); general statement about haze/attenuation is generic, not a description of their footage.
